clues.text: This city spreads across the flat delta of the Chao Phraya River. Its low streets sit near the river mouth, close to the sea.
clues.narrowing: Rules out highland and inland cities; puts the player on the Chao Phraya delta near the sea.

source.quote: in the Chao Phraya River delta in central Thailand

clues.text: This city has three seasons: hot, rainy, and cool. Monsoon rains start in May, and September soaks the streets the most.
clues.narrowing: Rules out four season lands; keeps a hot city with a long monsoon rainy season.

source.quote: The city experiences three seasons: hot, rainy, and cool, although temperatures are fairly hot year-round

clues.text: In 1782, a new king moved his capital across the river to an island. He set a city pillar there to mark the new start.
clues.narrowing: Shrinks the list to capitals founded by a king's move across a river in 1782.

source.quote: In 1782, King Phutthayotfa Chulalok (Rama I) succeeded Taksin, moved the capital to the eastern bank's Rattanakosin Island

clues.text: A grand palace stands by the river in this city. Bright temple roofs, like those of Wat Arun, shine close by.
clues.narrowing: Nearly decisive: a grand palace with famed temples like Wat Arun marks this city.

source.quote: The Grand Palace and Buddhist temples, including Wat Arun and Wat Pho

clues.text: This city is the capital of Thailand, and its Grand Palace still stands at its heart. The whole country's politics runs through its streets.
clues.narrowing: Confirms it: the capital of Thailand, with the Grand Palace at its heart.

source.quote: Bangkok, known in Thai as Krung Thep Maha Nakhon and colloquially as Krung Thep, is the capital and largest city of Thailand.

reveal.blurb: A small trading post grew here by the river long ago. In 1782 King Rama I moved the capital across the river and founded the city in earnest. Traders from far lands then helped it grow into a great port and royal city. Bangkok is the capital of Thailand.
